in_arabic.name: قدر
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'Q-D-R' meaning to measure, to weigh, to determine. In Islamic context, it is often associated with Allah's power and control over the universe and human destiny. It is also the name of the 93rd chapter of the Quran.

in_urdu.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'Q-D-R'. In Urdu, it is translated to 'قدرتا' which means 'power'. This name is often given to babies as a reminder of Allah's power and control over their lives.
